description: What a whole disk's /sys/block/<name>/stat says of its I/O: completed, the reads, writes, discards and flushes it completed (the fields the kernel gives: 11 before Linux 4.18, 15 until 5.4, 17 since), and in_flight, the requests under way. Anything else is an error.

cases.note: seventeen fields, since Linux 5.5: reads, writes, discards and flushes completed
fifteen fields, Linux 4.18 to 5.4: no flushes
eleven fields, before Linux 4.18: reads and writes
